# PDF dependencies

Bundled locally so exporting a timetable does not send its contents to another service.

- jsPDF 4.2.1: https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF — MIT; jspdf-LICENSE.txt.
- jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.9: https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable — MIT; autotable-LICENSE.txt.

Distribution files obtained from the corresponding versioned npm packages through unpkg.com on 2026-10-30. No runtime CDN dependency or HTML-to-canvas conversion is used.
